title: Free T3
attribution: Source: MedlinePlus, National Library of Medicine.
measures: Free T3 measures only the free, active form of triiodothyronine that enters the tissues. MedlinePlus notes that total T3 is considered the more accurate measurement of T3.
low: A low result may point to hypothyroidism, read together with TSH and free T4 to tell a thyroid cause from a pituitary one.
high: A high result may point to hyperthyroidism, again read together with TSH and free T4.
notes: T3 results are interpreted alongside TSH and T4 rather than alone. Some medicines and supplements can affect them.
